description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.

Heavy Attack

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.

Heavy Attack - Rhapsodic Riff

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
- After performing Basic Attack Stage 2 or Stage 4, hold Normal Attack to perform Heavy Attack - Rhapsodic Riff.
- After performing Mid-air Attack Stage 4, press Normal Attack to perform Heavy Attack - Rhapsodic Riff.

Mid-air Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.
Press Normal Attack following Mid-air Attack Stage 1 or Stage 2 to swing to the target with Grapple. Brant will attack the target if he reaches them with the swing. Release while in action to flip backward after the attack hits; or hold Normal Attack to attack the target continuously and flip backward after the finishing move. Brant flips backward automatically after Mid-air Attack Stage 3. Press Normal Attack after each flip to perform the next stage of Mid-air Attack. Flip resets Mid-air Dodge attempts.
- If Brant fails to reach the target with the Grapple swing of Mid-air Attack Stage 1, he instead performs a slash forward, dealing Fusion DMG.
- If Brant reaches the target with the Grapple swing of Mid-air Attack Stage 1 or Stage 2 but the attack fails to hit the target, he will drop down after a temporary suspension in mid-air.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Fusion DMG.

Heavy Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG.

Heavy Attack - Rhapsodic Riff

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG.
- Setelah melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 2 atau Tahap 4, tahan Normal Attack untuk melakukan Heavy Attack - Rhapsodic Riff.
- Setelah melakukan Mid-air Attack Tahap 4, tekan Normal Attack untuk melakukan Heavy Attack - Rhapsodic Riff.

Mid-air Attack

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Fusion DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack setelah Mid-air Attack Tahap 1 atau Tahap 2 untuk berayun ke target dengan Grapple. Brant akan menyerang target jika ia mencapainya lewat ayunan. Lepas saat beraksi untuk melompat mundur setelah serangan mengenai target; atau tahan Normal Attack untuk menyerang target terus-menerus dan melompat mundur setelah jurus penutup. Brant melompat mundur secara otomatis setelah Mid-air Attack Tahap 3. Tekan Normal Attack setelah setiap lompatan mundur untuk melakukan Mid-air Attack tahap berikutnya. Lompatan mundur mengatur ulang kesempatan Mid-air Dodge.
- Jika Brant gagal mencapai target dengan ayunan Grapple pada Mid-air Attack Tahap 1, ia akan melakukan tebasan ke depan, memberikan Fusion DMG.
- Jika Brant mencapai target dengan ayunan Grapple pada Mid-air Attack Tahap 1 atau Tahap 2 tetapi serangan gagal mengenai target, ia akan jatuh setelah melayang sesaat di udara.

Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack tepat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG.

description.en:
Brant launches himself into the air and blasts all targets in an area, dealing Fusion DMG. While in mid-air, if Bravo is not full, Resonance Skill Anchors Aweigh! is replaced with Plunging Attack.

Plunging Attack

Plunge at the target at the cost of STA, dealing Fusion DMG, which is considered Basic Attack DMG.
- If Brant fails to reach the target with the Grapple swing of Mid-air Attack Stage 1, he instead performs a slash forward. Afterward, press Normal Attack to perform Plunging Attack.
- If Brant reaches the target with the Grapple swing of Mid-air Attack Stage 1 or Stage 2 but the attack fails to hit the target, press Normal Attack to perform Plunging Attack during the suspension.
description.id:
Brant meluncurkan diri ke udara dan meledakkan semua target di suatu area, memberikan Fusion DMG. Saat di udara, jika Bravo belum penuh, Resonance Skill Anchors Aweigh! digantikan oleh Plunging Attack.

Plunging Attack

Menghunjam ke target dengan mengonsumsi STA, memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
- Jika Brant gagal mencapai target dengan ayunan Grapple pada Mid-air Attack Tahap 1, ia akan melakukan tebasan ke depan. Setelahnya, tekan Normal Attack untuk melakukan Plunging Attack.
- Jika Brant mencapai target dengan ayunan Grapple pada Mid-air Attack Tahap 1 atau Tahap 2 tetapi serangan gagal mengenai target, tekan Normal Attack untuk melakukan Plunging Attack selama melayang.

description.en:
Deal Fusion DMG to targets within the range and heal all nearby Resonators in the team before entering the Aflame state.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Aflame

The efficiency of gaining Bravo is increased by 100% when Normal Attack or Resonance Skill Anchors Aweigh! hits the target. Meanwhile, Forte Circuit Theatrical Moment is replaced by "My" Moment.

"My" Moment

Brant gains additional ATK based on his Energy Regen: For every 1% of his Energy Regen over 150%, Brant gains additional 20 points of ATK, up to 2600.
description.id:
Memberikan Fusion DMG ke target dalam jangkauan dan memulihkan HP semua Resonator di sekitar dalam tim sebelum memasuki kondisi Aflame.
Dapat dilakukan di udara.

Aflame

Efisiensi perolehan Bravo meningkat sebesar 100% saat Normal Attack atau Resonance Skill Anchors Aweigh! mengenai target. Sementara itu, Forte Circuit Theatrical Moment digantikan oleh "My" Moment.

"My" Moment

Brant mendapat tambahan ATK berdasarkan Energy Regen-nya: untuk setiap 1% Energy Regen di atas 150%, Brant mendapat tambahan 20 poin ATK, hingga maksimum 2600.

description.en: Healing provided by Waves of Acclaims is increased by 20%.
description.id: Pemulihan HP dari Waves of Acclaims meningkat sebesar 20%.

description.en: Brant's resistance to interruption is increased during Mid-air Attacks and gains 15% Fusion DMG Bonus.
description.id: Ketahanan Brant terhadap interupsi meningkat selama Mid-air Attack dan ia mendapat 15% Fusion DMG Bonus.

description.en:
Attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG, and gain Interlude Applause effect.

Interlude Applause

The next Mid-air Attack begins at Stage 2. This effect ends when Brant lands early or is switched out.
description.id:
Menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG, dan mendapat efek Interlude Applause.

Interlude Applause

Mid-air Attack berikutnya dimulai dari Tahap 2. Efek ini berakhir saat Brant mendarat lebih awal atau diganti keluar.

description.en:
Theatrical Moment

Brant gains additional ATK based on his Energy Regen: For every 1% of his Energy Regen over 150%, Brant gains additional 12 points of ATK, up to 1560.

Waves of Acclaims

Heal all nearby Resonators in the team when Bravo reaches 25, 50, 75, and 100.

Returned from Ashes

When Bravo is full, replace Resonance Skill Anchor Aweigh! with Returned from Ashes.
Consume all Bravo to perform Returned from Ashes, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG, and generate a shield for all nearby Resonators in the team. Casting this skill when in Aflame ends this state after Returned from Ashes ends.
- The shield cannot be transferred when the Resonator on the field is switched off.

Bravo

Brant can hold up to 100 Bravo.
- Obtain Bravo when Normal Attacks hit the target.
- Obtain Bravo when Intro Skill hits the target.
- Obtain Bravo when Resonance Skill hits the target.
description.id:
Theatrical Moment

Brant mendapat tambahan ATK berdasarkan Energy Regen-nya: untuk setiap 1% Energy Regen di atas 150%, Brant mendapat tambahan 12 poin ATK, hingga maksimum 1560.

Waves of Acclaims

Memulihkan HP semua Resonator di sekitar dalam tim saat Bravo mencapai 25, 50, 75, dan 100.

Returned from Ashes

Saat Bravo penuh, Resonance Skill Anchor Aweigh! digantikan oleh Returned from Ashes.
Mengonsumsi seluruh Bravo untuk melakukan Returned from Ashes, memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG, dan menghasilkan perisai untuk semua Resonator di sekitar dalam tim. Jika skill ini digunakan saat Aflame, kondisi tersebut berakhir setelah Returned from Ashes selesai.
- Perisai tidak dapat dipindahkan saat Resonator yang sedang di lapangan diganti keluar.

Bravo

Brant dapat menyimpan hingga 100 Bravo.
- Mendapat Bravo saat Normal Attack mengenai target.
- Mendapat Bravo saat Intro Skill mengenai target.
- Mendapat Bravo saat Resonance Skill mengenai target.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: Amplify the incoming Resonator's Fusion DMG by 20% and Resonance Skill DMG by 25% for 14s or until the Resonator is switched out.
description.id: Amplify Fusion DMG Resonator yang masuk sebesar 20% dan Resonance Skill DMG sebesar 25% selama 14 dtk atau hingga Resonator tersebut diganti keluar.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melakukan Tune Break pada target.

description.en:
Returned from Ashes temporarily causes nearby targets to stagnate while casting. The stagnation effect is removed when Brant is switched off the field.
After casting Intro Skill Applaud for Me! or each flip following Mid-air Attack, Brant's DMG dealt is increased by 20% for 5s, stacking up to 3 times.
description.id:
Returned from Ashes membuat target di sekitar terhenti sementara selama pelepasan. Efek terhenti dihapus saat Brant diganti keluar dari lapangan.
Setelah Intro Skill Applaud for Me! digunakan atau setiap lompatan mundur setelah Mid-air Attack, DMG yang diberikan Brant meningkat sebesar 20% selama 5 dtk, bertumpuk hingga 3 kali.

description.en:
Casting Mid-air Attack and Returned from Ashes increases Brant's Crit. Rate by 30%.
Brant's Outro Skill The Course is Set! gains a new enhancement:
When Resonance Skill cast by the incoming Resonator (or nearby Resonators who activate Brant's Outro Skill) hits a target within 20s after Brant's Outro Skill, Brant blasts the hit target, dealing Fusion DMG equal to 440% of Brant's ATK (considered Basic Attack DMG). This explosion can be triggered 1 time per second, up to 2 explosions in total.
- This effect remains active when Brant is switched off the field.
description.id:
Melakukan Mid-air Attack dan Returned from Ashes meningkatkan Crit. Rate Brant sebesar 30%.
Outro Skill Brant The Course is Set! mendapat peningkatan baru:
Saat Resonance Skill yang digunakan Resonator yang masuk (atau Resonator di sekitar yang mengaktifkan Outro Skill Brant) mengenai target dalam 20 dtk setelah Outro Skill Brant, Brant meledakkan target yang terkena, memberikan Fusion DMG sebesar 440% dari ATK Brant (dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG). Ledakan ini dapat terpicu 1 kali per detik, hingga total 2 ledakan.
- Efek ini tetap aktif saat Brant diganti keluar dari lapangan.

description.en: The DMG Multiplier of Returned from Ashes is increased by 42%.
description.id: Pengali DMG Returned from Ashes meningkat sebesar 42%.

description.en: The Shield obtained from Returned from Ashes is increased by 20%. Casting Returned from Ashes restores HP for all nearby Resonators in the team (6.60 HP for every 1% Energy Regen).
description.id: Shield yang didapat dari Returned from Ashes meningkat sebesar 20%. Menggunakan Returned from Ashes memulihkan HP semua Resonator di sekitar dalam tim (6,60 HP untuk setiap 1% Energy Regen).
